meta.description: Annotates VCF variants with functional consequences, population frequencies, and pathogenicity scores using bcftools annotate/csq, Ensembl VEP, SnpEff, and ANNOVAR. Use when deciding which annotation engine and version to pin, which transcript set to report on (MANE Select), reconciling HGVS 3'-shifting with VCF left-alignment, NMD status for PVS1, one calibrated predictor for PP3/BP4, or gnomAD grpmax filtering AF instead of a global AF cutoff.
meta.execution_note: Mode A. bcftools 1.24 (MSYS2 native Windows) for annotate/csq/+split-vep; cyvcf2 0.34 and Ensembl VEP 114.2 (bioconda) in micromamba envs inside the WSL 'agents' distro (/tmp); bcftools 1.21 there for Linux cross-checks. VEP ran against the synthetic GFF3/FASTA because no VEP cache is available offline; SnpEff and ANNOVAR were not executed (no database/licence), their commands were checked against the Skill text only. Pejaver 2022 thresholds were checked against the paper (PMC9748256, Table 2) and the VEP pick_order default against VEP 110/114 Config.pm. All variant data SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py seed 20260911; data/worst_vs_mane.vcf hand-written). Inputs executed: 7/7. Layer-1 avg 35.6/40, Layer-2 avg 50.3/60, assertion pass rate 22/28 (79%). scoring_rubric.md s.5 floor(s) not met for the numeric tier (assertion rate 0.786 < 0.9): grade downgraded one tier.

scientific_integrity.detail: References are real and correctly cited; REVEL thresholds match Pejaver 2022 Table 2. The statements that SIFT/PolyPhen-2 and raw CADD 'did not reach Supporting' are true only at developer thresholds (calibrated PolyPhen-2 and CADD reach PP3_Moderate) - an overstatement (P2), not fabricated data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 6 (patient pathogenicity question): annotation facts only, ClinVar treated as a lead, classification routed to clinical-interpretation / an accredited laboratory; no diagnosis or advice.

methodological_ground.detail: MANE-first reporting, one calibrated predictor, NMD 50-nt rule and grpmax FAF are sound; the usage-guide rare-variant recipe that clobbers INFO/AF is an implementation defect (P1), not a principled fallacy.

code_usability.detail: All SKILL.md bcftools/cyvcf2/VEP blocks parse and run (VEP with GFF in place of cache). Two runtime failures in Skill-provided code are recorded as P1: bcftools csq without --phase on unphased calls, and annotate recipes that stream an unindexed target into 'bcftools annotate -a <vcf>' (fails on bcftools 1.21 and 1.24).

functional_suitability.note: Covers engines, transcript sets, MANE, NMD, predictors and grpmax FAF. Correctness 2/4: csq command fails on unphased data; the usage-guide Basic/Clinical/Rare pipelines and the example's gnomAD branch pipe an unindexed stream into annotate -a <VCF>, which bcftools rejects; the Rare recipe overwrites the cohort's INFO/AF; '--pick defaults are canonical, biotype, rank, length, accession' is outdated for the pinned VEP 110+ (default pick_order starts mane_select, mane_plus_clinical).

reliability.note: Good symptom/cause/fix table (build mismatch, chr naming, MANE migration); runtime failures above are not anticipated.

performance_context.note: 188-line SKILL.md; usage guide (329 lines) carries the bcftools recipes.

agent_usability.note: Governing principle (annotation is a tuple, pin every axis) is excellent; recommends MANE Plus Clinical but its --pick_order example omits mane_plus_clinical.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts ('why do VEP and SnpEff disagree') in the usage guide.

security.note: Public database downloads only; no credentials.

maintainability.note: Example script's optional branch broken; no test data.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger; explicit 'Not for ACMG combining rules or final classification' handoff.

recommendations.title: Piped annotate recipes fail in bcftools
recommendations.problem: usage-guide Basic/Clinical/Rare pipelines and the example's gnomAD branch stream an unindexed target into 'bcftools annotate -a <vcf>', which bcftools 1.21 and 1.24 reject.
recommendations.root_cause: annotate with a VCF annotation file needs an indexed target; the recipes were not run.
recommendations.fix: Write each annotate step to an indexed -Oz file (or use a tab-delimited annotation source) and fix examples/annotate_vcf.sh accordingly.

recommendations.title: bcftools csq commands lack --phase
recommendations.problem: Every csq command exits on unphased heterozygous genotypes.
recommendations.fix: Use -p a|m|s explicitly and explain that -p a assumes cis for all hets (it merged a frameshift and a last-exon stop in Input 1).

recommendations.title: Rare-variant recipe clobbers the cohort INFO/AF
recommendations.problem: 'annotate -c INFO/AF' keeps the cohort AF where gnomAD has no record, so the 'absent' guard never fires and absent variants (incl. ClinVar P/LP leads) are dropped.
recommendations.root_cause: Source and target share the tag name; unmatched records keep their own value.
recommendations.fix: Annotate into a new tag (-c INFO/gnomAD_FAF:=INFO/fafmax_faf95_max) and filter on it, as SKILL.md's grpmax-FAF section implies.

recommendations.title: --pick default description outdated; pick_order drops MANE Plus Clinical
recommendations.problem: VEP 110+ default pick_order already starts mane_select, mane_plus_clinical; the Skill's recommended --pick_order omits mane_plus_clinical.
recommendations.fix: Describe the current default and use --pick_order mane_select,mane_plus_clinical,canonical,...

recommendations.title: Overstated SIFT/PolyPhen/CADD calibration claims
recommendations.problem: Skill says these never reach PP3_Supporting; Pejaver 2022 Table 2 gives PolyPhen-2 and CADD PP3_Supporting/Moderate at calibrated thresholds.
recommendations.fix: Say 'at developer-recommended thresholds' and point to the calibrated intervals.
